openings.claim: Hypothesis: eccentric left pressure elastically twists the hatch; centered seal contact can coexist with twisting, while untreated sliding reflects inadequate restraint. Change pressure carrier to a removable strip stiffener lashed solely to hatch; reversible padded rim clamps supply lateral restraint.
openings.discriminator: Against seal/rim fulcrum rocking, added stiffness at unchanged bearings and equal left force reduces opposite-corner lift.
openings.probe: Shared comparison below; defeat if adequate stiffening leaves lift unchanged.
openings.uncertainty: Sufficient strip stiffness and secure cord lashing are assumed; hatch-only attachment must add no rim bearing. Damage-free removable clamps require suitable rim geometry, which is unsupplied.

openings.claim: Hypothesis: a raised seal/rim bearing causes diagonal rocking; compliant seal can mark continuously when centered while permitting rocking and sideways slip. Replace increasing strap tension with clearance-limited padded strip clamps, retaining seal and permitting removable bearing adjustment.
openings.discriminator: Against elastic hatch twisting, hatch-only stiffening preserves approximately 2 mm opposite lift under equal left force because support fulcrum remains.
openings.probe: Shared comparison; defeat if stiffening suppresses lift with bearings demonstrably unchanged. Bearing adjustment remains a subsequent proposal, not deployment.
openings.uncertainty: Uneven support is assumed, not established by continuous contact. Strips creating clearance stops and sufficient lateral restraint within fabrication time is unproven.

lineage.reason: Relation, change, rival, defeat and assumptions retained; shared resource/stopping caveats below.
Relation, change, rival, defeat, adjustment caveat and assumptions retained; shared bounds below.

decision: Compare two reversible configurations differing only by hatch-only stiffening. First establish bearing invariance and useful stiffness or discrimination fails. Match 20 N left pressure using scale; ruler records opposite lift. Twelve closure/pull trials: six each, five normal checks during ten opening cycles, then one final disturbed closure with 1 mm card at marked right contact. Check position within 1 mm, 20 N sideways retention, one-technician reopening within 30 seconds, no new visible seal tears; disturbance exempts only seal continuity. Fabrication <=90 minutes, observation <=20; capacity unproven. Remove and cord-bundle all pieces when open, keeping full marked opening clear and loose parts recoverable. No powered mechanism; no drilling, cutting, gluing or permanent deformation of hatch/trough.
